input: registered checked Operation action bindings over exact fields and the same checked graph and composition boundary
representation: native async bound action function; static calls, not a runtime expression interpreter or class
dependencies: generated Rule v8, explicit factory v12 bindings, generated Event constructors and an explicit transaction port
factory_scope: existing v12 selection and invariant coverage; no fabricated validators or implicit extension adoption
parameter_capture: inert recursive snapshot before the first await; normalized core values and separately captured Event inputs
reads: transaction-local Entity reads by typed identity; missing or mismatched identities abort before commit
guards: all declared enforcing Rules in binding order; rejection aborts before write/Event preparation
writes: validate owned child values and selected base factory validators before preparing typed immutable raw-data write snapshots
events: construct each declared occurrence once after guards and write validation; clock dependencies explicit; no publication
result: normalize, validate through the selected owned-value providers, and freeze the explicit success result before commit

transaction_port.begin: establish an isolated read context; failure has no domain mutation
transaction_port.read: read only; never performs write effects
transaction_port.rollback: release a precommit context without domain mutation
transaction_port.commit: one immutable state-and-outbox batch; committed means all effects, rejected means none, indeterminate means unknown; no partial-success receipt
transaction_port.terminal: commit settles and releases the transaction for every returned disposition
transaction_port.uncertainty: exception or malformed receipt after commit attempt is indeterminate; never rollback or automatically retry after attempted commit
transaction_port.implementation_trust: the generated caller enforces ordering and one commit call; a provider must independently establish isolation, atomicity and durability

identity: source, action, profile, dependency plan and provider hashes are bound in the descriptor
compatibility: opt-in compiler candidate; no legacy typed Operation v1 reinterpretation, parser change, default switch, publication or runtime adoption
verification: native TypeScript and declaration compilation, independent source observation, hostile inputs, atomic-reference-store failures and compiling behavioral mutations
claim_ceiling: tested generated orchestration under the explicit provider contract; not production-store durability, distributed exactly-once delivery, public CLI integration or full PCR completion
